opportunities.name: Trip planning: flight + hotel + activity, saved to notes
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, search Google Flights, Booking.com hotels and Viator tour, then save a summary note of prices.
steps: On Google Flights set origin Paris, enter destination, pick departure and return dates, Search
On Booking.com enter destination and dates, Search, open top hotel and note name and price
On Viator search for the landmark tour, open top result and note title and price
Open notes, create new note 'Trip <city> <dates>: flight..., hotel..., tour...' and press Enter

opportunities.name: PyPI package comparison note
opportunities.description: Look up a Python package on PyPI, open its source repository for stars, and record version/date/stars/license in a notes comparison.
steps: Search package name in PyPI search box and press Enter
Open the package result and note version, date, license
Click Source/Repository link and note stars
After two packages, add a note comparing them

opportunities.name: Web feature support lookup and reply email
opportunities.description: Search caniuse for a web feature, check MDN page, then draft an email reply to a person with the supported browser version and docs link.
steps: Search feature name on caniuse and press Enter
Search the same feature on MDN and open its page
Open mail compose, enter recipient, subject 'Re: <feature> in <browser>', body with version and docs URL

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search by destination and dates
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a destination with given check-in/out dates and open a top hotel.
steps: Click destination box, select all, type city and choose option
Open date picker and select check-in and check-out
